charamote.name: Charamote
charamote.description: Its primary function is to reconstruct the bio-material used to regenerate Orokin structures. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.

charc-eel.name: Charc Eel
charc-eel.description: Discharges electricity from luminous glands along its flanks to stun its prey.

chondricord.name: Chondricord
chondricord.description: A triumph of Orokin bio-engineering, these hardy fish have adapted to the Deimos environment and seem oddly resistant to Infestation. They thrive in cave environments.

crewman-s-boot.name: Crewman's Boot
crewman-s-boot.description: While the Vallis coolant has kept this finely engineered Corpus tactical boot remarkably well preserved, it is, nonetheless, entirely worthless.

cryptosuctus.name: Cryptosuctus
cryptosuctus.description: Formerly Orokin scavengers, these fish succumbed to the Infestation long ago and now greedily feast on floating spores. They are found all over the surface of Deimos.

cuthol.name: Cuthol
cuthol.description: A grotesque crustacean that produces a potent, paralyzing toxin from its tentacles.
